title: Woodland Scout A-Z
hook: See it, name it, leave it where it should be.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: playful 3D woodland scout storybook, simple trail-map mood, green-gold palette, safe explorer tone, clear objects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a preschool field scout making safe observations and leaving wildlife, nests, mushrooms and logs undisturbed
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: walking 4/4 folk with pencil-tap pickups and open rests
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written field-note entries with visible evidence, safe distance, and concise facts
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: field-note cue -> recall beat -> target -> sketch/point/shape gesture, never collect
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. wood-flute or pizzicato leaf answers between target phrases
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: wood-flute or pizzicato leaf answers between target phrases
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make woodland exploration feel like careful field observation: notice evidence, sketch shapes, check a clue, and leave living things undisturbed instead of turning scouting into chasing or collecting.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child keeps a tiny field notebook; recurring verbs are notice, sketch, mark, compare, leave, check and observe-from-distance.
semanticArc: open the notebook at the trailhead
close the notebook and leave the woodland as found
forbiddenGenericLanguage: spot each woodland clue with me
